text: You're looking for a quick and healthy recipe that fits your dietary constraints and health goals. This Apple, Dried Cherry and Walnut Compote is a great option for you. As a vegetarian and dairy-free individual, you can enjoy this recipe without worrying about any allergens or dietary restrictions. The addition of walnuts provides a good source of fiber, which aligns with your health goal of increasing your fiber intake. The ingredients are also relatively low in calories, making it a great option for a snack or side dish that fits within your 60-minute time budget.
